verdict.rationale: Financial Connections documents API access to balances, ownership details and transaction history, with refresh-completion webhooks. It also lists an agent-oriented use case ('Financial insights for agents' via Link CLI), and the docs are machine-readable (llms.txt and .md pages). That supports programmatic, agent-oriented consumption of account data. However, nothing in the pack shows the response format or schemas, the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and there is no evidence of transaction enrichment such as categorization or merchant cleanup. Missing for 10: documented JSON response schemas or an OpenAPI spec for Financial Connections objects, transaction enrichment (categories, merchant normalization), and independent hands-on corroboration that the data is agent-consumable without parsing.
